evals.name: slow-sql-first-turn
evals.prompt: 我们一个接口 P99 从 200ms 涨到 900ms，帮我优化一下这几个慢 SQL
evals.expected_output: Grills on constraints, access, existing material and what was tried before giving expert suggestions; no SQL rewrites yet.
assertions: The response asks about the user's access, material (logs, monitoring) or what has been tried
The response does not rewrite or optimize SQL yet
The response does not adopt a 'senior DBA' persona

evals.name: homepage-post-grill-suggest
evals.prompt:
下面是这次会话到目前为止的记录，请只回复最后一条用户消息：

[用户]
/deeper 网站转化率低，想改首页文案

[助手]
（grill 完成）你的情况：B2B SaaS 官网，月访客约 8000；有 GA4 和 Hotjar（录屏+热图，已开 3 个月）；客服对话在 Intercom；没有 A/B 测试工具；两周内要给结论；上个月换了广告投放渠道。

[用户·最新]
情况就这些，你给建议吧。
evals.expected_output: Gives premise first (naming other causes such as the ad channel change), raw material naming Hotjar/Intercom, methods, proof without an A/B tool; marks known/unsure; user rules on each.
assertions: The first suggestion questions the premise and names the recent ad-channel change as a possible cause
Raw-material suggestions name the user's actual sources (Hotjar, Intercom or GA4)
The proof suggestion accounts for having no A/B testing tool
Claims are marked as known or unsure
The response asks the user to keep, edit or drop each suggestion
